mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, and thiazide diuretics can potentiate hypertensive effects through sympathomimetic mechanisms and may cause hypokalemia, increasing arrhythmia risk in patients on MAOIs.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; consider alternative antidepressant or diuretic; ensure adequate potassium levels; educate patient on dietary tyramine restriction.
